title: silene nutans subsp. glabra
intro: Silene nutans subsp. glabra, commonly known as Blunt-leaved Catchfly, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Silene nutans subsp. glabra include its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate congestion and reduce inflammation. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
